text:
jamal: Massive shoutout to @lucas (eng-sre), @tara (facilities), and @people-ops — you found the missing swag box and saved the all-hands demo. Bagels + tiny stickers left in the kitchen ❤️ :bagel: :tada:
lucas: it was literally behind a pallet under the loading dock. mystery solved. also, free coffee for the heroes. :mag: :coffee:
tara: facilities here — added extra labels and moved the box to the mailroom shelf. if anyone’s hungry, snag a bagel (fridge, labeled 'kudos'). :label: :bagel:
sophia: big thanks to @anna from support who spotted the courier SMS at 2:14am and pinged me. nothing like a midnight notification to spice up the week. :phone: :eyes:
anna: lol my phone’s notification saved the day. will accept praise and pastries as payment. :raised_hands: :bagel:
alex: who grabbed the tiny red "Launch" stickers? i can’t find mine and now i need it for my laptop. :eyes: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
maria: not me — but i did take an extra sticker for the office plant. she deserves recognition. :herb: :sparkles:
jamal: tiny update — if you grabbed swag, drop a quick emoji so we know what’s left. also, high-five to everyone who raced to help. made the demo feel calm again. :raised_hands: :sparkles:
delivery-bot: package_scan: "SWAG-BOX-#443" scanned at dock B 02:03 — moved to 3F mailroom.
lucas: extra kudos to the courier for not leaving it in the rain. will bring a bagel to whoever shares the best 'how it got lost' theory. :bagel: :thinking_face:
tara: real talk — if anyone sees unlabeled boxes in the future, tag #facilities and we’ll swoop. small stuff like this adds up. :pray:
jamal: agreed. leaving a public kudos here because cross-team hustle deserves mention. drop reactions or tiny victory stories below. :tada: (and help yourself to bagels!)
